title: LIPODOLOR - Pain thresholds in lipedema
summary: The pain sensitivity of pressure in lipedema patients will be compared to healthy controls.

interventions.name:
Gesunde Kontrollen:
1. Termin (Einschluss): Aufklärung und Einwilligung, Lipödem-Diagnostik
2. Termin (Messung): Druckschmerzschwellen-Messungen, Fragebögen
3. Anschluss: EMA (Ecological momentary assessment) über 4 Wochen

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
diagnosed lipedema (Study arm 1)
non-surgically treated lipedema (Study arm 1)
adults, competent to consent
Exclusion criteria:
Disorders of lipid metabolism (other than lipedema)
Status post liposuction
Bruising, injuries, or skin diseases in the examination areas
Pain patients (acute and chronic pain except lipedema)
Connective tissue diseases/infections
Patients with conditions that affect pupil size (e.g., status post cataract or glaucoma surgery)
Patients with conditions that affect pain perception (e.g., paraplegia, polyneuropathy, nerve entrapment syndromes affecting the treatment areas)
Fibromyalgia
Psychiatric disorders that may impair pain perception, expression, or assessment
